svg.text: The Story of Al-Zaeem Koshary Online

text.tspan: عمّ حسن صاحب محل «كشري الزعيم»، وقرر
أن يفتح موقعًا لطلب الأكل أونلاين.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: shop, and he decided to open a website

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: After a month, he said angrily:

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: But how did he know it failed?
